title: add benchmark-lab adaptive-batching reporting pipeline v78
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Adds v78 of the benchmark-lab reporting pipeline focused on adaptive batching telemetry and consolidated profiling baselines. Motivation: recent campaign of regressions and manual profiling showed variance in per-token latency under mixed workloads. This change centralizes adaptive-batching traces, adds a lightweight runner to collect representative workload traces, and expands the reporting pipeline to compute baseline deltas for regressions. Goals:
- surface batching effectiveness over time (per-model, per-seq-length)
- make profiling baselines queryable by date and runner
- add representative workload runner for multi-variant scenarios
- integrate with observability-pack dashboards

What changed (high-level):
- new pipeline DAG: benchmark_lab/pipelines/adaptive_batching_v78.py (schedules trace ingestion, aggregation, baseline comparison, and report export)
- runner: benchmark_lab/runners/representative_multi_variant_runner.py (captures synthetic and replayed traces with metadata)
- profiler: benchmark_lab/profiling/baselines_v2.py (adds compressed baseline snapshots and delta computation)
- metrics: benchmark_lab/metrics/batching_metrics.prom (adds per-batch-size latency distributions)
- dashboards: redwood-docs/observability/benchmark-lab-adaptive-batching.md (docs & example queries)

Checklist:
- [x] pipeline DAG implemented and unit-tested
- [x] representative runner with retries/backoff and KV cache warm-up
- [x] baseline snapshot format backward compatible (v1 -> v2 migration path included)
- [x] CI coverage for new modules
- [x] docs and example queries added

Testing and validation:
- ran end-to-end workload in benchmark-lab staging (n=3 runs) comparing adaptive batching on/off against profiling baselines; results stored in internal S3 prefix s3://redwood-bench/v78/
- added synthetic regression test that injects a deliberate latency shift and asserts delta detection triggers alert rule
- CI: unit tests, lint, and integration smoke tests all passed on the final run (see ci_checks).

Backward compatibility / migration notes:
- baseline snapshots saved in v2 format under /baselines/v2. Migration helper script benchmark_lab/profiling/migrate_baselines_v1_to_v2.py included and small (should be run once by ops).
- runner uses existing workload definitions; no changes required to user-facing configs.

Rollout plan:
- deploy pipeline to staging for 48h, validate alerting for known regressions, then promote to prod. Ops runbook and dashboard links included in docs file.

References: Linear ENG-8342, ENG-8410; support ticket SUP-1284; related PRs: pr-341000 (adaptive-batching v76) and pr-324790 (v74 improvements).
